paper_section: 5 Implementation details; 5.2 Ablation on calibration set size; Figure4
paper_observation: Eight diverse videos yielded sensitivity profiles close to those from the larger calibration set. This observation does not prove convergence for every checkpoint or target shape.
our_protocol: Eight independently selected real Mixkit clips; native LTX0.9.6 checkpoint and evaluated shape/schedule; unchanged old/new cache thresholds; independent paired test prompts and seeds.
